chapter: Billie Holiday, Basie leadership and studio work
title: Sound tracks forgotten; winding down
summary: He remembers few tracks, would do only recordings and TV, and wants everything he does to be good.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Are there any other sound tracks (inaudible) remember the names of?

Not really. I can't remember the names of any sound tracks. Once I leave the studio, I sort of black my mind out on the tunes and I'm going on to the next thing. I very seldom remember any tunes. But if I should ever happen to have to play it again, I can play it exactly the way I played it the first time.
Like in the case of 'Rockin' and Rhythm,' (inaudible).
But you worked in the studios steadily all the way -- during your entire time in California?

Yeah, as a matter of fact, if I had my choosing, had my 'druthers, as they call it, that's all I would like to do is specific types of work wherein I would make recordings of either records or TV shows, etcetera.

Well, I'm trying to wind down now, not wind up. I've had a very nice life at this business and I'm not looking 20 years ahead at this particular stage, as a lot of young people in the business. I'm trying to make sure that whatever I do from now on is thought well of and only good because at this stage of my life, I have no room for bad.
You don't do bad things. That's not (inaudible).
Even Joe Louis got knocked down a few times by palookas. knocked him down and he was not really a good fighter.
